column1: # EXP-R2-245 stage 29: the two ProGen3 rungs on the N-to-C direction, and the two
# ProGen2 rungs this measurement had not carried.
# THE ESTIMAND IS UNCHANGED AND THE COHORT IS THE SAME FILE. Per wild type, the
# Spearman correlation between an arm's summed log-likelihood of a rendered
# variant and that variant's measured folding stability, ddG_ML. Per-wild-type
# correlations are averaged inside a unit and the unit is resampled; a design's
# unit is its design series and a natural's is WT_cluster. The cohort is the
# census certified by EXP-R2-190 and not a draw -- 130 certified zero-hit design
# wild types over 40 series (36 of them wholly zero-hit, 110,730 variants) and 266
# natural domains over 124 WT_cluster units (404,114 variants), 412 wild types and
# 527,204 variants in all -- read from the file whose SHA-256 is
# caaa233dc44146d4fca40087b431e49aea97d073f864b04168e0a764ad400205, staged once at
# the run root and recomputed by every payload. The baselines and the seven free
# and fragment-level gates are the frozen ones; nothing is recomputed and no
# threshold is retuned. The verdict rule is designed_referent.arm_verdict and is
# applied afterwards, not here. Like-for-like with EXP-R2-244 by construction:
# same cohort file and digest, same baselines, same rule.
# WHY THE PROGEN3 CELLS EXIST. Both rungs' published scoring convention is the
# mean of the N-to-C and C-to-N summed log-likelihoods, and this stage sums
# left-to-right. By decision of this measurement the rungs are scored on the
# single N-to-C direction: the estimand is one functional compared across many
# arms, a bidirectional mean is a functional no other arm here carries, and the
# strata rule requires that one name mean one functional and that a deviation be
# declared -- not that an author's convention be obeyed. So the rungs are read on
# the N-to-C stratum and their payloads record scoring_stratum
# n_to_c_summed_log_likelihood. THE TWO PROGEN3 READINGS ARE SEPARATE
# FUNCTIONALS: this N-to-C designed-referent reading and the lineage's
# bidirectional ProteinGym reading that 20_retrieval_bound.py produces. They are
# never pooled, ranked together, or converted into one another, and
# scale_comparison.require_uniform_stratum refuses a pairing that would.
# WHAT THE PROGEN3 SCORER RENDERS AND WHAT IT SCORES. The rendering is the
# lineage's own: prepare_clm builds "1" + sequence + "2" and wraps it in <bos> and
# <eos>, and the scorer calls the preparer with reverse=False, so the direction
# marker is the lineage's N-to-C marker rather than one this stage invents. The
# SCORED TARGET SET IS THE SEQUENCE'S RESIDUES 1..L AND NOTHING ELSE:
# progen3.scored_logits applies residue_target_mask, which excludes "1", "2",
# <eos>, <bos>, <pad> and <mask>, so the three marker positions of every record
# are context and not targets. Before that repair they were inside the sum -- no
# other arm in this stage scores a marker -- so these magnitudes are not those of
# a marker-inclusive reading. Measured on Compute before dispatch, on CPU at
# bfloat16: a 29-residue sequence renders to 33 tokens, its scored targets number
# exactly 29, and three marker targets per record are excluded. Weights are
# reached through progen3.load_progen3 and not through AutoModel -- the Hugging
# Face eager MoE path loads random experts and still runs -- and
# progen3.self_check runs before any wild type is scored, with its verdict in the
# payload. The declared context ceiling on both rungs is 65536 positions against
# a rendering of L + 4 tokens and a cohort whose longest wild type is 72
# residues, so the over-context skip is reachable and does not fire.
# WHY THE PROGEN2 CELLS EXIST. ProteinGym measures all five ProGen2 rungs and this
# measurement reached only medium, large and xlarge, so the ladder could not be
# read across the two experiments. These two cells close that gap, and they carry
# a second thing worth having: the pair is scored twice, once on 2026-08-13
# without a recorded stratum (results/transfer/designed_referent/) and once here,
# on the identical cohort file, so the two passes are a reproduction diagnostic of
# the frozen numbers as well as the payloads that carry the label. NO CODE CHANGE
# WAS NEEDED FOR THEM and none was made: both are PANEL members, stage 29's door
# has admitted them since the first round and both are in its DEFAULT_ARMS, and
# designed_referent.ARM_IDENTIFICATION already carries an entry for each. Their
# rendering is n_to_c_control, "1" + sequence, whose marker is the first token and
# is therefore context by construction and never a scored target; the scored set
# is the sequence's residues. bfloat16, which is the precision the 2026-08-13
# payloads were taken at.
# CARDS. Re-read in the pod immediately before dispatch, where all four were idle
# and the four cells fit in ONE slot; an earlier reading had two other agents'
# cells running on two of the cards, which is why the cards are re-read rather
# than taken from the revision before it. The queue runner refuses a card that is
# not idle rather than sharing it, so a card that goes busy after this line is
# written refuses the cell instead of corrupting two measurements, and a refused
# cell is not complete and is re-dispatched rather than counted. One slot, four
# cards, one cell each: the barrier has nothing to wait for and the whole round is
# minutes rather than hours.
